free_tier.stated: Starter 2GB VPS at USD 16.99/year (USD 1.42/month): 1 Intel Xeon core at 2.0 GHz or faster, 2 GB guaranteed memory, 30 GB NVMe, unmetered bandwidth on a 1 Gbps shared port, Linux SSH and root. The 8 GB plan is USD 59.99/year with 2 cores and 60 GB NVMe; the 16 GB plan is USD 111.11/year with 4 cores and 240 GB NVMe. All plans carry a promo code and annual billing.
